column1: # 0x82303110 -- the position integrator. Cycle 1368.
# 359 instructions; .pdata declares 359 and short=0.
# HOW IT WAS FOUND, after A3.2 had eliminated six data-following approaches:
#   cycle 1365  the naive vector signature matches 461 functions -- useless
#   cycle 1366  li rN,64 + stvx128 + lvx128, with LIVENESS tracked -> 10
#   cycle 1367  all ten read: nine copy a pose, one differences two. NONE integrates.
#               So the vector form is ruled out over a complete population.
#   cycle 1368  the SCALAR form -- lfs then fmadds then stfs at the same
#               displacement -- gives 9, of which THREE touch all three components.
# THE STEP, read instruction by instruction:
#   lfs    f8,72(r30)               the current component
#   fmuls  f9,f0,f31                a velocity term scaled by f31
#   fmadds f9,f9,f13,f8             f9 * f13 + f8
#   stfs   f9,72(r30)
#   ... the same for 68(r30) and 64(r30)
# Three fmadds, one per component of a 3-vector at +0x40, +0x44, +0x48. That is an
# Euler step: position += rate * factor.
# columns: what value note
factor f13
floor clamp
column3: applied to the MIDDLE component, +0x44, after the step

column1: components
column3: the locator translation row's first three floats

column1: # 1/3.6 IS THE KM/H TO M/S FACTOR. That is an observation about the number, not a
# claim about the game's units: what is measured is that the constant is
# 0.2777777910232544 and that it multiplies a rate before it is added to a
# position. f31 multiplies the rate first and is not established.
# The middle component alone gets a minimum of 10.0. It is NOT called altitude
# here; what is measured is which component is clamped and to what.
# AFTER THE STEP the function normalises a vector with the vrsqrtefp
# Newton-Raphson sequence and stores three floats to r31+0x80/+0x84/+0x88.
# NOT ESTABLISHED: what f31 is; what object r30 and r31 are; what the other two
# all-three-component candidates (0x8222EC18 and 0x82304AB8) do.
# HOW IT IS REACHED, and why sixteen cycles of following data never got here.
# 0x82303110 has NO DIRECT CALLERS. Its only non-.pdata reference is a single
# .rdata word at 0x8200F2EC, which is slot +0x7C -- index 31 -- of a 36-slot
# vtable based at 0x8200F270.
# That vtable has ZERO at vtable-4, so it carries no Complete Object Locator and
# is one of the 306 unnamed vtables cycle 1348 counted. Its class has no RTTI and
# the class map cannot name it.
# So the integrator is a virtual method of an unnamed class, invoked only through
# a vtable. Every approach that followed data from a named entry point was
# structurally unable to arrive: there is no `bl` to follow.
# columns: what value
vtable base
slots
integrator slot
RTTI
